verdict.rationale: Ledgy is a SaaS equity-management platform, so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The cited material covers only API authentication, cap table features and permissions, none of which is about this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
